fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M7684 (CI on a PR that changes only .rhiza/). The planner read .github/workflows/ci.yml (lint, scripts x4, api x2, rest, budgets and an aggregate check job; triggers pull_request and workflow_dispatch on a sha, checkout fetch-depth 0), the Makefile targets (lint = fmt-check + vet + self-check), internal/ciworkflow's tests of ci.yml, and ship check's checksVerdict (SKIPPED already counts as passing, untested) and shipRerunFailed. It raised three choices as one question: the intent to serve, how ci.yml detects a model-only PR and what runs then, and whether ship check gets its own test leaf. No owner took part; the arbiter answered with Decision decision-model-only-ci: no serves link (a standalone owner request); a plain-git `changes` job (code=true on any path outside .rhiza/, always true on workflow_dispatch) gating the five Go jobs, a `model` job running make self-check when code=false, and `check` as the single aggregate passing on success-or-skipped with changes succeeded; and a separate internal/api test leaf for the SKIPPED verdict and rerun.
fields.title: Plan interview: CI on a model-only PR (autonomous)
